いつもお世話になります。
もし宜しければ以下の通りお願いいたします。
なお、「個人的にそういった画が見てみたい」だけで、「ビスマス様の世界観の中での実場面」を想定しているわけではありません（勝手にキャラを拝借してしまい恐縮です…）。

※キャラと装備
・獅童絢瀬さんで、制服姿。
・左手は素の義手のまま、右手は極薄ゴム手袋着用。
・左手については、もし可能であれば、義手の上に極薄ゴム手袋を着用した差分があると大変嬉しいです。

※構図
・獅童さんの状態（車椅子、車椅子以外の椅子等に座っている、立っている、等）はお任せ。
・小～中型の自動拳銃（銃種はお任せ/未認可品を想定）に消音器をクルクルと捻じ込んでいるところ。

※背景
・完全にお任せいたします。

Hello,

I wanted to request your character Tsubasa Saeki in a skimpy outfit of some sort. Originally it was a cow bikini, but I’ll leave it up to you what outfit you’d like to draw. 

Her pose in the artwork will be holding her hair into twintails at the side of her head (like Eris Greyrat). She will have a tsundere expression, either frustrated, furious, or embarrassed. Your choice. Also, you can choose if you’d like her middle fingers to be extended while she holds her Twintails, doing the “fuck you” gesture.

For the second artwork, if it is okay, I would like you to draw Tsubasa (in the same outfit or a different one) again inflicting pain on a male’s testicles, if that is okay. The male will be unclothed, while Tsubasa will be mostly or fully clothed. I was thinking the scene would be a footjob that is very aggressive, maybe even with her shoes or boots on. I’ll let you decide the exact details of the position both characters are in, the viewpoint, and expression. And alternatively, if you have an idea that you’d like to draw instead that fits the specific SM I’m looking for, feel free to draw it instead as long as it’s CFNM.

With the little bit extra left behind, I’ll let you decide what you’d like to do. I think it’s too little for another artwork. But if it’s not, something with Kanzaki Aria in her micro bikini maid outfit (AmiAmi reference) would be cool, especially with her pistols out.

If not, just add some versions or draw whatever you like of Tsubasa.

Thank you
